preservation_evidence.scope: all finite declared path lengths, both controller states, and all spectator multiplicities

rule_claims.subdivide: Subdividing one path edge produces a path one edge longer and leaves the controller and spectators unchanged.
rule_claims.close: Adds only the optional controller edge and leaves the path and spectators unchanged.
rule_claims.open: Deletes only the optional controller edge and leaves the path and spectators unchanged.
